title: Korean AI startup Upstage says it is in talks to acquire 10K of AMD's MI355 chips, in a bid to "diversify to other chips" as "we have a lot of Nvidia chips" (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Korean AI startup Upstage says it is in talks to acquire 10K of AMD's MI355 chips, in a bid to “diversify to other chips” as “we have a lot of Nvidia chips” — Korean AI startup Upstage is in discussions with Advanced Micro Devices Inc. to buy 10,000 of its latest AI accelerators …
contentText:
Bloomberg :

Korean AI startup Upstage says it is in talks to acquire 10K of AMD's MI355 chips, in a bid to “diversify to other chips” as “we have a lot of Nvidia chips”   —  Korean AI startup Upstage is in discussions with Advanced Micro Devices Inc. to buy 10,000 of its latest AI accelerators …
